abilities.name: Aether Pulse
abilities.description: Slam your interface into the ground and release a shockwave that damages, knocks back and staggers nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Phase Dash
abilities.description: Phase forward through space. Invulnerable while phasing.

abilities.name: Core Break
abilities.description: Leap and drive the Core's power into the ground, devastating everything nearby.

abilities.name: Echo Sight
abilities.description: Attune to Aether echoes. Reveals hidden objects, collectibles, secret paths, lore, and phased enemies.

abilities.name: Phase Step
abilities.description: A fast evasive step. Longer invulnerability than Phase Dash, shorter distance.

abilities.name: Resonance Burst
abilities.description: Release stored resonance in a spinning burst that shreds shields and stuns enemies.

tree.name: Concussive Pulse
tree.description: Aether Pulse staggers even elite enemies and knocks back further.

tree.name: Twin Phase
tree.description: Store a second Phase Dash charge.

tree.name: Deep Echo
tree.description: Hidden caches and collectibles within 60 m are marked on your HUD while Echo Sight is active.

tree.name: Ghost Step
tree.description: Phase Step invulnerability lasts twice as long, and a perfect dodge refunds energy.
